description: Generate a before, after or around plugin class and its di.xml declaration for a public method of a class or interface, adapted from the official plugins docs. Returns the files for the caller to write. Use it to change the behavior of a core or third-party method without rewriting the class.

area.description: di.xml area: global (etc/di.xml) or an area folder (default global)

basePath.description: Module directory relative to the Commerce root (default "app/code/<Vendor>/<Module>")

module.description: Module name as Vendor_Module (e.g. "Acme_Reviews"), as registered in registration.php

targetClass.description: Class or interface whose public method is intercepted (e.g. "Magento\Catalog\Model\Product")

type.description: Plugin type. The docs advise after over around unless the chain must be stopped.

name: add-plugin

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the Commerce root

source.description: Documentation page the template was adapted from

title: Add a plugin (interceptor)
